title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Calculation - Carb Counting
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A diabetic patient plans to eat the following lunch: 1 cup of cooked pasta (45g carbs), 1 slice of bread (15g carbs), and 1 small apple (15g carbs). How many carbohydrate exchanges (servings) does this represent?
questions.explain: One carb exchange/serving is 15g. Total grams = 45 (pasta) + 15 (bread) + 15 (apple) = 75g. $$75g / 15g = 5$$ servings.
